subject: LOGO
source_sentence: To ensure robust validation , as suggested by recent cheminformatics guidelines36,37, Leave-One- Group - Out (LOGO) cross - validation is employed; by systematically holding out all data points corresponding to a specific salt, C4H9(C2H5)3NI, to test model generalization on unseen compounds .
